trust_decision.summary: The gate trusts `credential.source` — the payer DID asserted by the caller in the payment credential — as proof that the caller controls that wallet, and returns a free-access receipt whenever the named wallet meets the configured on-chain conditions; the decision is made in conditionGate's gatedVerify.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names a free-access grant on a self-declared wallet; the only place a wallet is taken from a caller-supplied value is gatedVerify, which reads params.credential.source and parses it into a wallet, then grants at src/index.ts:452-459.

fix_sites.entry_point: conditionGate(server, options) -> returned Method.AnyServer.verify(params), invoked by mppx's route handler (the package is a library adapter, so the public entry point is the exported factory plus the wrapped verify hook)
fix_sites.module_kind: library adapter / wrapper (mppx Method.Server composition; no HTTP route or CLI of its own)

fix_sites.entry_point: tokenGate(server, options) - v1 predecessor's equivalent wrapper, created by the fix at legacy/mppx-token-gate/src/index.ts; the file is new at the fixed state and has no pre-fix form in the pinned tree
fix_sites.module_kind: legacy predecessor package (added by the fix already fixed, not modified at the pin)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route exists at the pinned commit: the only grant is inside gatedVerify. The nearest dismissal-looking surface is the `broadcast` method hook, which the pinned wrapper never touches - it is copied through by the spread at src/index.ts:467-470 and only ever returns a normal paid receipt, so there is no unproven grant on it to close (the fix adds gating there as new free-access behaviour, fix.diff:951-954).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The free-access feature itself and its documented fallbacks must keep working: a wallet meeting the conditions still receives a `condition-gate:free:{attestationId}` receipt without payment, and the documented fail-open (attestation API unreachable -> normal paid path, so qualifying wallets pay during an outage) must survive. A fix that just deletes the grant, or that refuses free access whenever proof is uncertain, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: provenPayer as a did:pkh:eip155:<chainId>:<0x...> DID -> {address, type:'evm'} (fix.diff:748-749)
provenPayer as a did:pkh:solana:<chainId>:<addr> DID -> type 'solana' (fix.diff:750-751)
provenPayer as a did:pkh:xrpl:<chainId>:<r...> DID -> type 'xrpl' (fix.diff:752-753)
provenPayer as a did:pkh:bip122:<chainId>:<addr> DID -> type 'bitcoin' (fix.diff:754-755)
provenPayer as a bare 0x EVM address -> accepted only because it is unambiguous (fix.diff:757-758)
provenPayer as an explicit {address, type} object (fix.diff:740-744)
provenPayer null / undefined / empty string -> no payer, paid path (fix.diff:738)
provenPayer as a bare non-EVM address, or an object without type -> rejected, fail closed (fix.diff:742, 759)
credential.source: no longer read at all, so every source shape (EVM/Solana/XRPL/Bitcoin DID, absent, unparseable) becomes inert (fix.diff:839-944)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second public gate entry point (e.g. tokenGate) in the same wrapper style that derives the payer from credential.source and returns the same free receipt
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: upstream's own fix creates exactly this sibling as the v1 predecessor package at legacy/mppx-token-gate/src/index.ts (fix.diff:141-400): identical tokenGate(server, options) signature, identical Method.Server wrapper and source-based grant, with its own parsers and its own module-level cache; a maintainer keeping a compat shim in our copy is the same thing one directory away.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cache-first grant path that returns a free receipt from a wallet-keyed cache entry before any proof of control is obtained (the cache at src/index.ts:168 is module-global and shared across gate instances)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: every /v1/attest call costs the operator credits (README.md:144-146, README.md:164), so caching on the wallet address is an obvious maintainer optimisation; the fix's own test targets precisely this replay path (fix.diff:1153-1172), which makes a planted copy a how-type sibling rather than another route.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an exported payer-normalization helper that accepts the credential or its DID and returns a wallet, usable by callers directly and by a sibling gate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix introduces normalizeProvenPayer as public API in the same file (fix.diff:735-760); the natural earlier variant is the reverse helper - normalize a payer out of the credential - which reopens the same trust of an asserted value while looking like harmless parsing.

out_of_scope_notes: src/index.ts:438-443: with `conditions: []` and matchMode 'all', pass follows attestation.pass, so an empty condition list could grant free access vacuously; a misconfiguration/functional edge, not the advisory's asserted-identity property, not pursued.

src/index.ts:178-185: cacheKey lowercases the address for every wallet family although Solana/XRPL addresses are case-sensitive; a cache-collision edge unrelated to the advisory's property, not pursued.
